messages:
Mia (Marketing): ok team — greenlight for the public announce tomorrow 10:00am PST. final checklist: changelog link, docs URL, canary timing, webinar CTA, inbound routing. @Jake @Sam please confirm by EOD :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Jake (Engineering): on it. changelog is at https://git.redwood.ai/repo/commits/3f9a2b1 — that's the final set of runtime perf fixes + fallback policy. can we freeze any more changes?
Olivia (Product): freeze yes. no more changes except hotfixes. marketing copy will link to that commit for the rough changelog and we’ll link formal release notes once staged.
Sam (Docs): docs staging URL: https://docs.redwood.ai/staging/release-3.8.1 — will merge to production on deploy. ETA for merge: 09:30am PST tomorrow after canary verification.
Mia (Marketing): perfect. canary window? we need 30m canary starting at 08:30am PST so docs have time to propagate before 10am announce.
Jake (Engineering): canary 08:30–09:00 with 10% traffic. After quick metrics check we can promote. Will pin rollback window to 09:30–09:45 in case of issues.
Mia (Marketing): ok routing: inbound leads go to Support queue -> SDR triage. @Olivia confirm the SDR brief will be ready?
Olivia (Product): SDR brief will be in Notion under Marketing > Releases > 3.8.1 by 07:00am PST. includes pitch, known regressions, playbook for escalation.
Sam (Docs): note: the docs prod URL will change once merged. marketing should link to the prod docs URL in the announcement. I will post the final prod link here when the merge completes.
Mia (Marketing): also webinar: we have the CTA for the 11/5 webinar. marketing will include a small banner in the announce and a separate webinar mailer 30m after announce.
Jake (Engineering): deploy-bot will create the deploy ticket and post status. I’ll be oncall for the canary.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by Jake for 08:25am PST — canary start 08:30am. CI pass ✅. Auto-rollback enabled.
Mia (Marketing): outstanding items: (1) Sam to paste prod docs link in this thread after merge, (2) Jake to confirm canary metrics ok by 09:05am, (3) Olivia to drop SDR brief link. if all green we hit 10:00am announce. :thumbsup:
Sam (Docs): prod docs link: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/3.8.1 — merged and live. :white_check_mark:
Jake (Engineering): canary metrics: p50/p95 token latency within SLOs, error rate <0.1% — all green at 09:07am. promoting to full roll at 09:10am.
Olivia (Product): SDR brief: https://notion.redwood.ai/briefs/3.8.1 — added escalation contacts and quick FAQ.
Mia (Marketing): awesome — final announce copy will go out at 10:00am PST. publishing checklist done. thanks everyone, I’ll post the release tweet + blog link when live. :tada:
